domain: non-fundamentals price/volume - EODHD daily OHLCV only, name-level; no SEC fundamentals fields anywhere (A6 wave-diversity axis)
title: Down-day dollar-volume composition premium: names whose traded dollar volume concentrates on down days

mechanism_question.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: Impatient risk-reducing sellers (stop-loss orders, margin desks, deleveraging funds, index-deletion and mandate-forced sellers) transact disproportionately on down days; their supply arrives as marketable order that limit-order suppliers must absorb and inventory overnight. The patient side (liquidity providers, NAV-constrained holders) is slow to react, repositioning over weeks, so the pressure is not cleared within the session.
mechanism_question.why_the_effect_exists: Suppliers of immediacy who chronically absorb one-sided down-day dollar flow bear transient inventory risk and demand compensation (Grossman-Miller 1988; Nagel 2012). Where down-day flow is non-informational liquidity trading, price declines on heavy volume mean-revert as suppliers are paid for risk-bearing (Campbell-Grossman-Wang 1993; Coval-Stafford 2007). Conversely, names whose dollar volume concentrates on up days carry attention-driven, patient-buyer demand that is already optimistically priced and underperforms. The cross-sectional aggregate is a flow-composition discount that clears as expected return.
mechanism_question.what_observable_measures_it: DVOL_share(i,d) = sum over the trailing 63 sessions t of DVOL(i,t) * 1[r(i,t)<0] divided by sum of DVOL(i,t), where DVOL(i,t) = RAW close * RAW volume and r(i,t) = RAW close-to-close return. It uses only the sign of the daily return as a volume-partition label - never return magnitude, never variance, never a volume level ratio. Sort: long highest DVOL_share tercile, short lowest.
mechanism_question.when_it_must_fail: (a) when down-day flow is informed (persistent fundamental deterioration) the pressure does not revert within the 21-session holding window and the anchor turns negative; (b) when liquidity suppliers are capital-constrained the inventory premium evaporates exactly when measured (Nagel 2012) and pressure persists; (c) when the composition premium is smaller than its own band-cost drag (band-C names) it is untradable; (d) it must fail the moment the unweighted down-day-frequency control reproduces it, because then the PnL is return-path exposure, not dollar-flow composition.
mechanism_question.what_control_kills_convenient_explanatio: FREQ_share control (identical window, unweighted fraction of negative-return days) removes the volume weighting that carries the flow story; a within-window sign-permutation feature placebo preserves each name's sign frequency, volume series and variance but destroys sign-volume alignment; drop-one-symbol and fold-removal kill single-name and single-regime artifacts; the band-aware stress rerun kills 'premium = illiquidity cost subsidy'.

falsifiable_prediction: Long-high minus short-low DVOL_share tercile book (gross 1.0, net ~0, terciles ~130 names per leg given p2 eligible populations of ~390-408 names per decision) has positive expectancy AFTER band-aware base costs, position PF >= 1.1, >= 2 of 3 folds positive, risk-matched incremental alpha > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds; the FREQ_share control's absolute alpha is < 0.5 x anchor alpha (stage-A control gate). Family is falsified if the anchor is non-positive after base costs, if the FREQ_share control matches or outruns the anchor, or if the sign-shuffle placebo book reproduces the anchor within noise.

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti: Sole inputs are EODHD daily RAW OHLCV from the 409 sha256-pinned files in p0a_eodhd_price_manifest.json (staged .staging_prices_v8/eod); adjusted series used only as the authorized cross-check. Observables: DVOL(i,t) = RAW close_t * RAW volume_t; r(i,t) = RAW close-to-close return; DVOL_share and FREQ_share over a trailing 63-session window; ADV63 = median(RAW close*RAW volume) over 63 sessions ending at the decision session (P3 band definition). Availability semantics: each daily bar is readable at session close + 1 session (P3 v8_additions.availability_convention), so a decision at session d uses bars through session d-1 and is never conditioned on the decision session's own bar. Rebalance clock stated explicitly: decisions occur every 21st S0 session, indexed from each fold's first eligible decision session; this cadence is session-index-anchored and calendar-blind. The 154-clock citation rule is vacuous for this proposal: no PIT conditioning is used and no clock is cited.

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.eligibility: per P3 floor at each decision session: filer in the frozen 410-filer panel; servable by the authorized price authority at that decision (per-name facts from p2_coverage_first.json); ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; band D excluded); RAW price >= 1.00 USD. p2 band populations at boundary dates: start A=286/B=94/C=10 (390 eligible), mid A=307/B=87/C=11 (405), end A=376/B=31/C=1 (408).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup: 63 servable sessions of history required before the first decision in each fold (63-session window and ADV63 share the same warmup).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.rebalance_clock: every 21st S0 session from the fold's first decision session; no calendar-month anchoring.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding: 21 sessions (to the next decision); book forced flat at every fold boundary; gross = 1.0 (0.5/0.5 long/short), net ~0, CASH absorbs residual and is excluded from turnover/concentration/drop-one.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fills: decision computed on bars through session d-1; fills at the next allowed session after the decision, close-to-close execution per V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill.

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: 63-day DVOL_share cross-sectional rank book, long top tercile / short bottom tercile, equal-weight within legs, +/-1-decile hysteresis on tercile membership.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: 126-day DVOL_share (same flow-composition observable at double horizon; 126-session warmup for this arm only). Intended profile: Spearman with anchor ranks ~0.5-0.7; a positive but weaker expectancy supports the mechanism (neighbour_mechanism_support required). If the neighbour flips sign, the composition story is horizon-fragile and the family is downweighted regardless of the anchor's outcome.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.causal_negative_control: FREQ_share = unweighted fraction of r<0 days over the same 63 sessions, same tercile book machinery. L7 intended correlation profile: Spearman(anchor, control) ~0.35-0.55, rank-distinct BY CONSTRUCTION because a sharp low-volume down day counts fully in the control but barely in the anchor - the control deletes exactly the dollar-weighting the mechanism claims is load-bearing. The control must NOT reproduce the anchor: gate is |control alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor alpha| (control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt). If the control reproduces or outruns the anchor, the PnL is return-path exposure, not flow composition, and the family is falsified per the frozen causal_control_rule.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.secondary_placebo: feature-level sign-shuffle: within each name-window, permute up/down labels across sessions (fixed ex-ante seed) preserving sign frequency, volume series and variance but destroying sign-volume alignment; placebo ranks are expected near-uniform and the anchor must beat the placebo book.

incremental_alpha_test: Per the frozen factor_and_benchmark contract: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule), computed per fold and overall; gate: overall incremental alpha > 0 and >= 2 folds positive. Second benchmark: equal-weight sector ETF total return (optional sector factor, authorized data) as the sector-relative test; report arm-minus-sector-factor per fold. Raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha. PnL is booked after band-aware base costs in all alpha computations.
base_and_stress_costs: Liquidity-band model per P3 v8_additions, applied to BOOKED PnL, linear in fills, charged exactly once per side per fill, no sidecar. Base: band A 10 bps/side, band B 15, band C 25. Stress: 2x base (A 20, B 30, C 50). Band assignment per ADV63 at each decision (PIT). Expected annualized two-way turnover ~4.5-6.5 (raw; ceiling-normalized 6.0 also reported) implies base cost drag ~45-165 bps/yr depending on realized band mix (p2 shows the book is dominated by bands A/B), stress drag ~90-330 bps/yr. Both base and stress reruns are declared deliverables.
turnover_and_sample_floor: Decision cadence 21 sessions over 1,837 S0 sessions gives ~86 decision periods total (floor: >= 30 required) and ~28/29/29 per fold S0_FOLD_1/2/3 (floor: >= 5 required). +/-1-decile hysteresis holds expected raw two-way turnover near/below the 6.0 annualized ceiling; both raw and ceiling-normalized turnover reported per the frozen convention (sum |delta w| over non-CASH legs).
drop_one_design: (1) value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. (2) fold removal: expectancy recomputed with each fold dropped; survival iff min over folds > 0. (3) anchor-extreme robustness: rerun excluding the single highest-DVOL_share name at every decision. All drop-one runs inherit identical eligibility, band costs and fill clock.

failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_controls_negative: flow-composition premium absent in this panel - plausibly because institutional-quality SEC filers are too liquid for the inventory premium to clear band costs; report margin-to-fail per P-2.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_raw_negative_after_costs: premium exists but is smaller than its own liquidity cost; check whether it survives in bands A/B only.
failure_interpretation.FREQ_share_control_reproduces: return-path exposure, not dollar-flow composition - family falsified (L7 rule applied, no rescue).
failure_interpretation.only_fold_2_positive: COVID-era deleveraging artifact, not a persistent mechanism.
failure_interpretation.neighbour_126d_sign_flips: horizon fragility; composition story not robust.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_all_folds_and_gates: confirmatory path continues to Stage-A with the preregistered parameters only; no re-tuning.

source_to_test_map.inputs: .staging_prices_v8/eod (409 sha256-pinned EODHD RAW daily files per p0a_eodhd_price_manifest.json); servability and boundary-band facts from p2_coverage_first.json; folds, eligibility floor and band cost model from p3_invariants_freeze.json; forbidden screen against forbidden_family_inventory.json.
source_to_test_map.pipeline: per-name RAW OHLCV -> DVOL/FREQ/ADV63 (63-session windows) -> cross-sectional ranks at each 21-session decision session (bars through d-1) -> eligibility + band assignment -> tercile book with hysteresis, gross 1.0 -> next-session close-to-close fills -> band-aware cost model on booked PnL -> folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 -> stage-A gates + FREQ_share control + sign-shuffle placebo + drop-one + stress rerun.
source_to_test_map.not_touched: research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.py (no PIT conditioning in this arm); no SEC fundamentals fields read anywhere.

forbidden_inventory_screen.A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM: PASS - no sector-ETF return enters the signal or book; ETFs appear only as frozen benchmark/sector-factor context, never as signal.
forbidden_inventory_screen.A5-SFV2-TREND-DEFENSIVE: PASS - no SMA/EMA/trend filter, no vol-target overlay, no defensive rotation; book always invested gross 1.0 with no market-timing state variable.
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL: PASS - no return-shock/crash/overshoot observable; the signal never ranks return magnitude or residuals (a name with 63 tiny down days scores DVOL_share=1.0 at ~zero cumulative return; a big up-day name can still carry a mid DVOL_share). Preregistered documentation: Spearman(DVOL_share ranks, 63-day cumulative-return ranks) measured and reported before scoring, expected negative with |rho| <= 0.5; flag >= 0.6.
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE: PASS - 21-session cadence anchored to the S0 session index, blind to calendar months and settlement cycles; no calendar state anywhere.
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV4-A5-H1-PARTICIPATION-SHIFT: PASS - no 21d-vs-252d dollar-volume ratio, no fresh-vs-stale volume shock, no stale-rank inversion. DVOL_share is an intra-window composition share, invariant to proportional rescaling of ALL volume inside the window, and therefore structurally incapable of expressing a fresh/stale LEVEL ratio.
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE_and_vol_le: PASS - no variance, no squared returns, no vol-level term enters any sort (volume weights x sign indicators only). The measured-closed vol-level shadow region (rho 0.319 > 0.20) is not re-entered and neither binding re-entry door is invoked. Preregistered documentation before selection: Spearman vs the 63-day semivariance-share feature ranks, vs 63-day realized-vol-level ranks, and vs the 21d/252d dollar-volume-shock ranks, each expected < 0.5 and flagged at >= 0.6; measured, never argued in prose.
forbidden_inventory_screen.EQ_S2_A3_F1_PIT_RECON_FLOW: PASS - no PIT reconstruction or flow claims; per the no_ohlcv_proxy_rule this arm fabricates no fundamental or macro proxy from OHLCV and makes no PIT claim.
forbidden_inventory_screen.A5-S2-F1-LENDING-CONSTRAINT-PREMIUM: PASS - no securities-lending or borrow data.
forbidden_inventory_screen.generic_mechanisms: ordinary cross-sectional momentum: PASS (returns never ranked; return sign is used only as a volume-partition label and the FREQ_share control is designed to absorb any pure sign-frequency content). time-series trend/vol-target standalone: PASS. long-SPY/sector-beta dressing: PASS (risk-matched incremental alpha is the declared gate; book is ~net-zero cross-sectional). quote-spread without authorized PIT data: PASS (no quote data; deliberately NO spread estimator, e.g. Corwin-Schultz, is used as a mechanism to keep maximal distance from this generic veto). daily-indicator grids: PASS (one mechanism, one observable, parameters 63d/21d/terciles/hysteresis fixed ex ante, no grid). new accounts/paid data/network fetch: PASS.
forbidden_inventory_screen.blocked_data_channels: PASS - only EODHD All World owner-entitled (AUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_RESEARCH, all six gates pass) is read; no Stooq (V8 probe-terminal BLOCKED), no Twelve Data (V7 BLOCKED), no Massive Basic (CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED).
